description_short: Recolor buildings with persistent global colors and per-mesh overrides, a draft preview, and custom paint tools.
description_long: Adds Recolor's complete building color palette plus an optional More workspace with dedicated Edit Mesh, Mesh Templates, and Settings tabs. Global Colors and per-building Mesh Overrides are saved with the world. Global Paint applies the active palette color with left-click and picks a building's Global Color with right-click. The two-stage Mesh Eyedropper picks a source with left-click, then transfers both its Global Color and complete Mesh Overrides to exact prototype-and-schema matches; right-click steps back or exits. Select Without Inspector defaults on, is remembered, and works only while Recolor is open. Edit Mesh retains its isolated draft preview, linked-LOD logical groups, one-step Undo, remap-aware input legends, and native confirmation prompts for destructive whole-building actions.
